class.name: OcgTdocstdXlinkroot
class.brief_description: This attribute is the root of all external references contained in a Data from TDF. Only one instance of this class is added to the TDF_Data root label. Starting from this attribute all the Reference are linked together, to be found easily.

method.name: Set
